children: Cognition AI, which offers an AI-powered coding and engineering platform, has entered talks for a new $2B funding round, which would elevate the startup to a $75B valuation, according to Bloomberg.

The San Francisco-based company has already raised more than $3B this year in other funding rounds, according to the report. Some of Cognition's clients include Wayfair
